summary_for_children: Al-Ma'un means Small Kindnesses. It warns against pushing away orphans, not feeding the poor, praying to show off and refusing small help.
environment_concept: A neighbourhood where kindness to orphans, feeding the poor and lending small things matter.
architecture_and_scenery: Street with homes, a well and tools to lend.
